title: Gerente Executivo De Inteligência Operacional
description:
Na RD Saúde, você vai acelerar seu aprendizado em um ambiente dinâmico, com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional.

Somos líderes no mercado brasileiro de farmácias, com lojas em todo o país e mais de 60 mil pessoas apaixonadas por cuidar de gente. Trilhamos um caminho de desenvolvimento que impulsiona carreiras e transforma futuros. Juntos por uma sociedade de mais saudável impactamos mais de 1 milhão de vidas e queremos ir ainda mais longe — de forma sólida, humana e lado a lado com você. Venha fazer parte dessa jornada e trilhar um caminho que transforma.

Principais Responsabilidades:

1. Mapeamento, Padronização e Melhoria Contínua de Processos

- Mapear, analisar, redesenhar e otimizar processos ponta a ponta, garantindo eficiência operacional, conformidade regulatória, escalabilidade e foco no cliente interno.

- Atuar de forma transversal junto às lideranças das áreas, promovendo visão integrada dos fluxos, redução de retrabalhos, mitigação de riscos operacionais e financeiros e diminuição de tempos de ciclo.

- Abranger processos das seguintes áreas: Contas a Pagar, Contas a Receber, Fiscal e Tributário, Custos, Contabilidade, Legalização de Lojas, Folha de Pagamento e Benefícios

- Atendimento de chamados provenientes das Lojas e Centros de Distribuição (CSC), incluindo demandas de folha, benefícios, manutenção de lojas e rotinas administrativas e operacionais.

- Implementar metodologias de melhoria contínua e excelência operacional, garantindo padronização e sustentabilidade dos ganhos.

2. Liderança das Frentes de Automação, Inteligência Artificial e Dados

- Liderar a célula de Automação, Inteligência Artificial e Dados, atualmente com aproximadamente 400 robôs em produção, assegurando: governança do pipeline de automações, estabilidade e resiliência operacional, e evolução tecnológica contínua e mensuração estruturada de ganhos de produtividade e retorno sobre investimento (ROI).

- Definir, priorizar e executar o roadmap estratégico de automação e uso de IA aplicada a processos administrativos, financeiros e operacionais.

- Coordenar a estratégia de dados da diretoria, incluindo:

- Desenvolvimento e evolução de BI's executivos e operacionais

- Gestão de data lake e fontes de dados

- Definição e monitoramento de indicadores de desempenho, produtividade, SLA, qualidade e eficiência

3. Políticas, Normas e Governança de Processos

- Estruturar, revisar e manter políticas, normas e procedimentos da diretoria, assegurando: conformidade legal, regulatória e fiscal, padronização operacional em larga escala e clareza de papéis, responsabilidades e níveis de decisão.

- Atuar como guardião dos processos críticos, garantindo sua correta aplicação, atualização contínua e aderência às melhores práticas de mercado.

4. Governança, Metas e Gestão Executiva

- Estruturar e liderar o modelo de governança da diretoria, incluindo: definição e gestão de metas, KPIs e OKRs, rituais de acompanhamento, fóruns executivos e comitês de decisão e monitoramento de performance e direcionamento estratégico.

- Gerir o orçamento da área, incluindo investimentos em tecnologia, automação, dados e projetos de melhoria contínua.

- Elaborar e apresentar materiais executivos para diretoria e comitês, com visão analítica, estratégica e orientada a dados.

5. Gestão de Projetos e Evolução de Sistemas

- Liderar projetos estratégicos de implementação, evolução e otimização de sistemas que suportam o CSC e Suprimentos Indiretos, incluindo: ERPs, sistemas fiscais, financeiros e de folha de pagamento, plataformas de chamados, automação e analytics.

- Atuar como interface entre áreas de negócio, tecnologia e fornecedores, assegurando entregas dentro de prazo, custo, escopo e qualidade esperados.

- Garantir alinhamento entre soluções tecnológicas e objetivos estratégicos do negócio.

Requisitos:

  • Superior completo.
  • Experiência executiva sólida em: Centros de Serviços Compartilhados, processos financeiros, administrativos, contábeis e fiscais, transformação operacional em ambientes complexos e de grande escala.
  • Liderança de iniciativas de automação, dados e analytics.
  • Vivência em organizações com alto nível de governança, controles e exigências regulatórias.
  • Desejável formação complementar ou certificações em: Gestão de Processos (BPM, Lean, Six Sigma), Gestão de Projetos (PMI, PMP, Agile, Scrum).
  • Automação de Processos (RPA).
  • Data Analytics, BI e Inteligência Artificial aplicada a negócios.
  • Governança, Riscos e Compliance.

title: Country Manager (Brazil)
description:
About the Client

Client is a fintech company building cross-border payments infrastructure using stablecoins to improve speed, cost efficiency, and global scalability.

The Role

Client is hiring a Country Manager to own the Brazil business end-to-end. This is a senior leadership role for someone who has built, run, and scaled a financial technology operation in Brazil before — and who sees stablecoins as the inevitable future of the country's payments infrastructure.

You will be the most senior executive in Brazil, responsible for the full scope of country operations: revenue growth, team building, regulatory positioning, partner relationships, and market strategy. You'll work directly with global leadership to define and execute Brazil's expansion roadmap, while serving as the primary face of Client to customers, regulators, and the broader ecosystem. Brazil is a top-priority market in Latin America. This role carries real weight and real autonomy

What You'll Do

Own the Brazil P&L

  • Take full accountability for Brazil's revenue targets, cost base, and commercial performance
  • Build and execute a multi-year country growth strategy aligned with global objectives
  • Report directly to global leadership with full visibility into country-level metrics, pipeline, and operational health
  • Make resource allocation decisions for the Brazil business, including headcount, partnerships, and local investments

Build & Lead the Local Team

  • Hire, develop, and manage a high-performing local team across sales, business development, operations, and compliance
  • Create a culture of ownership, urgency, and customer focus
  • Partner with global HR, Finance, and Legal to build the right local infrastructure as the team scales
  • Serve as a player-coach in the early stages — willing to roll up your sleeves on deals, regulatory filings, and partner negotiations while the team is still being built

Drive Commercial Growth

  • Own the full go-to-market strategy for Brazil, targeting fintechs, banks, PSPs, and large corporates
  • Personally lead and close strategic enterprise deals with senior finance, treasury, and payments leaders
  • Build and leverage your existing network in Brazil's payments ecosystem to generate pipeline and unlock key accounts
  • Develop and manage referral partnerships in the FX and banking sectors
  • Position stablecoin infrastructure as a strategic advantage — articulating FX savings, settlement speed, treasury optimization, and new product opportunities

Navigate Regulation, Compliance and Operations

  • Serve as the primary point of contact with Brazilian regulators, including the Banco Central do Brasil (BCB) and CVM
  • Oversee the local compliance function and ensure operations remain aligned with Brazilian financial regulations, VASP frameworks, and AML/KYC requirements
  • Monitor the evolving regulatory landscape — Pix developments, crypto licensing, foreign exchange rules — and proactively adapt strategy
  • Coordinate with global Legal, Compliance, and Risk teams to manage audits, licensing requirements, and regulatory filings
  • Build and maintain relationships with banking partners, payment providers, and required local infrastructure partners
  • Work with global and local teams to ensure customer success and operational execution

Represent Client in Market

  • Act as the most visible leader in Brazil — across events, conferences, media, and regulatory forums
  • Build trusted relationships with C-suite stakeholders, partners, and ecosystem players
  • Provide global leadership with ongoing market intelligence: competitive dynamics, regulatory developments, and customer needs
  • Contribute to broader LATAM strategy, with potential to expand scope over time

Influence Product & Strategy

  • Act as the voice of the Brazilian market internally — translating customer and regulatory needs into product direction
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Compliance to ensure market fit
  • Help build the playbook for expansion in large emerging markets

What We're Looking For

Must Have

  • 10- 15+ years of experience in financial services, fintech, or payments
  • 3–5+ years in a country management, general management, or senior leadership role in Brazil
  • Demonstrated track record of owning P&L and driving commercial growth
  • Deep expertise in Brazil's payments and FX landscape — including cross-border flows, treasury operations, and regulatory environment (BCB, CVM)
  • Experience with crypto, stablecoins, or blockchain-enabled payments
  • Proven ability to hire, lead, and develop teams in a high-growth environment
  • Strong network with senior decision-makers across fintechs, banks, and PSPs in Brazil
  • Ability to navigate complex regulatory and compliance environments
  • Native Portuguese and professional English proficiency
  • Based in São Paulo with willingness to travel internationally

Nice to Have

  • Experience with leading financial institutions or high-growth fintechs
  • Experience engaging with regulators on licensing or compliance frameworks
  • Background in treasury, FX trading, or payments operations

The Profile

  • You've owned and scaled a market, built teams, navigated regulators, and closed meaningful deals
  • You understand how Brazil operates — commercially, operationally, and culturally
  • You're comfortable operating across executive, commercial, and regulatory environments
  • You bring structure to ambiguity while remaining adaptable
  • You believe in the evolution of payments infrastructure and want to lead that shift in Brazil

Compensation / Benefits

  • Total compensation includes base salary, commission, and equity

title: Learning & Development Expert
description:
Job Summary:

The Learning Expert is responsible for applying employee training programs, conducting training needs analysis, and developing engaging learning content. This role ensures smooth training logistics, maintains training records, and supports the continuous improvement of L&D initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Training Program Application

  • Schedule, organize, and deliver training programs through lectures, workshops, videos, e-learning, and blended formats.
  • Apply training logistics, including scheduling, venue bookings, facilitator coordination, and employee enrollment.
  • Maintain and update the Learning Management System (LMS) and training records.
  • Handle administrative duties such as tracking attendance, sending reminders, and managing training budgets.

2. New Employee Orientation Facilitation

  • Design, update, and facilitate engaging onboarding programs for new hires.
  • Collaborate with HR and department leaders to ensure a smooth transition for new employees.
  • Continuously improve trainings based on feedback and evolving company needs.

3. Training Needs Analysis & Evaluation

  • Conduct surveys, interviews, and performance assessments to identify skill gaps.
  • Monitor and evaluate training effectiveness through feedback, quizzes, and KPIs (e.G., completion rates, performance improvement).
  • Adjust training programs based on data insights to enhance engagement and knowledge retention.

4. Content & Training Material Development

  • Create and update training manuals, guides, job aids, and digital resources for employee learning.
  • Develop interactive content (e-learning modules, videos, quizzes, presentations).
  • Ensure materials comply with company policies and industry standards.

5. Training Delivery & Facilitation

  • Conduct engaging live and virtual training sessions for employees at all levels.
  • Use diverse training methods (role-playing, simulations, discussions) to maximize learning.
  • Provide post-training support to reinforce key concepts.

6. Stakeholder Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with department heads to align training with business goals.
  • Support ad-hoc Learning initiatives (leadership development, new employees training, etc.).
  • Promote a culture of continuous learning through newsletters, LMS updates, and recognition programs.

7. Qualifications & Skills:

  • Experience: 7+ years in Learning, training application, or HR, including facilitation and content creation.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluent in English (written and spoken).
  • Technical Skills (Preferred/Nice-to-Have): Familiarity with LMS platforms and e-learning tools and knowledge of MS Office (PowerPoint, Excel) and video training software.
  • Soft Skills: Strong organizational and project management abilities, Engaging facilitator with excellent presentation and communication skills. Analytical mindset to assess training effectiveness and adapt programs.

A COFCO International é uma empresa global de agronegócios que compra, armazena, vende, processa e distribui commodities agrícolas essenciais: grãos, oleaginosas, açúcar, algodão e café. Com sede em Genebra, na Suíça, a COFCO International emprega cerca de 11 mil profissionais, em 37 países, e possui ativos em todos os continentes, com negociações em mais de 50 países. A COFCO International é uma plataforma de agronegócios da COFCO Corporation, uma das maiores companhias agrícolas e de alimentos da China, com atuação global.

Responsabilidades

  • Responsável por todos os aspetos financeiros das transações comerciais relacionadas ao algodão no Brasil;
  • Participar e gerenciar a preparação das demonstrações financeiras de acordo com as IFRS;
  • Realizar uma revisão detalhada do balanço patrimonial e do P&L para garantir a conformidade com os requisitos de relatórios do Grupo;
  • Auxiliar o Controller a consolidar a análise mensal das contas do balanço patrimonial, desenvolver políticas e procedimentos para os negócios no país;
  • Revisar e testar mensalmente a reconciliação do inventário entre o sistema de contabilidade, o sistema de negociação e as demonstrações de terceiros;
  • Revisar o cálculo dos juros e a utilização do capital de giro para a estratégia do Brasil;
  • Revisar as vendas mensais, despesas gerais e administrativas e lançar os acréscimos conforme necessário;
  • Preparar e gerir o processo de planeamento orçamentário para os negócios no Brasil e execução para outras regiões dos negócios;
  • Responsabilidade pelos processos diários de relatórios para o negócio: P&L e Posição. Gerenciar a coleta de dados e garantir a precisão das informações enviadas à gerência;
  • Reconciliação da contabilidade P&L do final do mês das operações no Brasil com a análise de diferenças do P&L comercial;
  • Fornecer análises detalhadas de fim de mês das mesas de operações individuais às equipas de FP&A e Estratégia para relatórios de P&L e posição da estratégia do Brasil;
  • Gerenciar a auditoria interna e externa do negócio no Brasil, o que inclui coordenar os requisitos que estão a ser encaminhados para outras áreas funcionais.
  • Atuar de forma independente, sendo o principal ponto de contato para a empresa em quaisquer questões relacionadas com finanças;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com o Controller Regional de Algodão e os líderes comerciais e funcionais para garantir a implementação da estratégia comercial no Brasil;
  • Manter a estrutura de relatórios alinhada com as necessidades comerciais.

Requisitos

  • Licenciatura em Contabilidade, Finanças ou Gestão;
  • CPA é desejável;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Experiência em ambiente de negociação de commodities e gestão de equipes diretas;
  • Experiência comprovada em contabilidade ou controle de negociação;
  • Desejável experiência com SOX;
  • Competências avançadas em Excel e BI/Análise;
  • Conhecimento emcontabilidade comercial, legislação relacionada, regulamentos e procedimentos de reporte para cumprir com as IFRS e a legislação local;
  • Capacidade de identificar oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Liderança e resolução de conflitos;
  • Capacidade de priorizar e gerir várias tarefas simultaneamente com sentido de urgência.

A COFCO International é uma empresa que promove a igualdade de oportunidades. Todos os talentos qualificados são bem-vindos e considerados para nossas vagas, sem distinção de raça ou etnia, crença religiosa, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, idade, pessoa com deficiência (PcD) e outras características protegidas por lei.

Para saber como a COFCO International coleta e processa os seus dados pessoais durante a sua candidatura de emprego, por favor consulte a nossa Política de Privacidade .

title: Regulatory Affairs Analyst
description:
Job Title: Regulatory Affairs (RA) Analyst

About the Position

The Regulatory Affairs Analyst will be responsible for managing regulatory submissions and ensuring compliance with local and international regulatory requirements. This role plays a key part in supporting new product registrations, post-marketing activities, and regulatory strategy execution within the pharmaceutical domain.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

  • Prepare, review, and submit high-quality CTD dossiers for new drug product registrations and post-marketing variations in compliance with regulatory requirements.
  • Prepare and respond to Deficiency Letters issued by ANVISA, ensuring timely and accurate submissions.
  • Conduct risk assessments and gap analyses to enhance regulatory processes and improve dossier quality.
  • Develop and implement regulatory strategies for Pharmaceutical Equivalence Studies and Biowaivers, including coordination of outsourcing activities.
  • Support and monitor the importation process in line with regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Evaluate regulatory feasibility and identify potential risks or requirements to support project execution.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Regulatory Affairs or Technical Documentation within the pharmaceutical industry.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biology, Biomedicine, or a related field.
  • Strong working knowledge of ANVISA regulations, as well as international regulatory guidelines and processes.
  • Proven ability to manage regulatory documentation with accuracy, attention to detail, and compliance focus.

title: Purchasing Manager
description:
SWM International is a multinational company specialized in producing paper for the tobacco industry and solutions in specialty papers. We are expert manufacturers of a variety of advanced materials that are part of people's everyday lives. We contribute to our customers' success by delivering high-quality products and collaborating to provide innovative and customized solutions that enhance the value of their offerings.

Now, we invite you to be part of our daily journey, where each employee is essential to the success of our company.

Bring your talent to SWM!

We are currently looking for a Purchasing Manager to join our team in a permanent position at our unit in Piraí, Rio de Janeiro.

Position Objective

Lead regional operational buying teams in executing global procurement strategies while managing supplier relationships locally and interfacing with key stakeholders like plant operational and maintenance teams. This role ensures compliance, operational excellence, cost optimization, and supply continuity by bridging the gap between corporate global strategy and regional business needs.

Your challenges will include:

1. Operational Leadership & Strategy Execution

  • Manage Regional Buying Teams: Lead and develop the operational procurement team to ensure high performance, process compliance, and professional growth.
  • Implement global framework agreement: work closely with category leaders to roll out global contracts regionally, ensuring local requirements are met without compromising global leverage.
  • Drive orocess excellence: Apply Lean/Six Sigma principles to streamline the "procure-to-pay" cycle and improve regional buying efficiency.

2. Market Intelligence & Analysis

  • Monitor market trends: Analyze regional indices, competitor behavior, and technical developments to forecast price fluctuations and supply risks.
  • Benchmarking: Regularly compare regional pricing and commercial terms against competitors to maintain a competitive edge while ensuring full legal and anti-trust compliance.
  • Data-driven reporting: Consolidate market research and internal KPIs into actionable monthly reports to guide executive decision-making.

3. Supplier & Stakeholder Management

  • Local face to suppliers: Act as the primary regional point of contact for key suppliers to resolve escalations, conduct performance reviews, and ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are met.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify supply chain bottlenecks and develop alternative sourcing formulations or backup plans.
  • Sourcing: Lead team to run competitive tenders for categories under direct responsibility

4. Continuous Improvement & Compliance

  • Knowledge Leadership: Stay current on industry innovations and digital procurement tools to suggest improvements in commercial positioning.
  • EHS & Quality Standards: Ensure all regional purchasing activities strictly adhere to Health, Safety, Environment, and corporate governance guidelines.
  • Compliance: Establish and enforce local procedures, ensuring transparency in the purchasing activities

What we're looking for:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Administration, Engineering, or related fields
  • Experience: Solid knowledge of purchasing processes, negotiation, and import/export regulations;
  • Technical Skills: Training in Purchasing and Supply Chain/ Proficiency in Microsoft Office/ Experience with ERP and P2P softwares.
  • Languages: Fluency in English, any other language is a plus
  • Availability to travel.

What we offer:

  • Health Insurance: SUL AMÉRICA – Family – Nationwide coverage (free monthly membership)
  • Eye Care: Reimbursement of up to R$ 544.00 (frames and lenses) per year.
  • Group Life Insurance: Sul América Insurance, with monthly employee contribution through payroll deduction.
  • Dental Plan: Amil 700, family, with national coverage.
  • Private pension plan
  • Christmas gift card
  • Meal voucher
  • On-site meals
  • Pharmacy voucher
  • Transportation allowance
  • Toys – children up to 12 years old
  • Bonuses based on goal achievement

title: Geotécnico(A) Pleno
description:
Geotécnico(a) Pleno

Local: Fazenda Brasileiro – Teofilândia (BA), Brasil

Quantidade de Vagas: 01

Modelo de Trabalho: Presencial

Disponibilidade: Mudança para a região (empresa oferece suporte)

Sobre a Oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Geotécnico Pleno para atuar em operação de mineração a céu aberto (open pit), com papel estratégico na estabilidade geotécnica e segurança das operações.

Será responsável pelo monitoramento de cavas, taludes e pilhas de estéril, além de acompanhar as atividades de curto prazo, garantindo aderência aos parâmetros geotécnicos.

Procuramos um profissional com experiência em geotecnia aplicada à mineração, conhecimento em mecânica de rochas e atuação em gestão de riscos. Vivência em open pit é essencial, sendo diferencial experiência em mineração subterrânea.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar o monitoramento geotécnico de cavas, taludes, pilhas de estéril e estruturas associadas;
  • Analisar a estabilidade de taludes em mina a céu aberto (open pit) e/ou subterrânea;
  • Acompanhar as atividades operacionais de curto prazo, garantindo conformidade com os parâmetros geotécnicos;
  • Interpretar dados de instrumentação geotécnica (piezômetros, inclinômetros, radar, entre outros);
  • Elaborar e revisar relatórios técnicos geotécnicos;
  • Desenvolver e validar modelos geotécnicos e geomecânicos;
  • Propor e acompanhar medidas de mitigação de riscos geotécnicos;
  • Atuar na gestãode riscos, assegurando a segurança das operações de mina;
  • Apoiar no planejamento de lavra, fornecendo recomendações geotécnicas;
  • Participar de investigações geotécnicas (campo e análise de dados);
  • Garantir o cumprimento de normas e padrões de segurança aplicáveis;
  • Interagir com equipes multidisciplinares (geologia, planejamento, operação).

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação superior em Engenharia (preferencialmente de Minas, Geológica ou Civil) ou Geologia;
  • Experiência comprovada em geotecnia aplicada à mineração;
  • Vivência em operações de mina a céu aberto (open pit);
  • Vivência com monitoramento geotécnico, instrumentação e análise de estabilidade de taludes, cavas e pilhas de estéril;
  • Desejável experiência em operações que possuam mina subterrânea e mina a céu aberto simultaneamente e/ou em interação direta (cava sobreposta ou operações integradas);
  • Disponibilidadede mudança para Teofilândia, BA.

title: Analista De Sustentabilidade
description:
Local: Capelinha - MG - Aperam Bioenergia

A Aperam BioEnergia, líder em inovação e sustentabilidade, está em busca de uma pessoa Analista de Sustentabilidade para integrar a equipe.

A Aperam BioEnergia se consolidou como referência em inovação e sustentabilidade no Vale do Jequitinhonha, produzindo carvão vegetal de alta eficiência para a fabricação do Aço Verde Aperam, além de tecnologias, mudas e sementes.

Com certificação FSC e ISO 14001 e 45001, nossas florestas renováveis de eucalipto combinam proteção ambiental, responsabilidade social e viabilidade econômica, destacando-se por um manejo baseado nas melhores práticas.

Ao utilizar 100% de carvão vegetal em nossos altos-fornos, na usina siderúrgica de Timóteo (MG), conseguimos reduzir significativamente a nossa pegada de carbono. Isso quer dizer que, além de altamente eficiente, o nosso aço contribui para um futuro mais limpo e sustentável.

Valorizamos pessoas e comunidades, promovendo saúde, segurança e programas sociais que transformam vidas. Na Aperam BioEnergia, sustentabilidade e inovação caminham lado a lado para criar um impacto positivo, corajoso e duradouro.

Se você é apaixonado(a) por sustentabilidade e quer fazer parte de uma transformação positiva no setor florestal, esta é sua oportunidade!

Por que escolher a Aperam?

Somos um lugar incrível para trabalhar! No segmento de Agronegócio, conquistamos o 1o lugar no Prêmio "Lugares Incríveis para Trabalhar", posição que mantemos há seis anos. Esse reconhecimento reflete o nível de satisfação de nossas pessoas colaboradoras e nossa excelência em gestão de pessoas, clima organizacional e liderança.

Acreditamos que a diversidade fortalece nossa equipe e que a inclusão é essencial para um ambiente mais inovador e colaborativo. Buscamos pessoas que queiram crescer em um time que valoriza diferentes perspectivas e experiências.

Se você tem paixão por sustentabilidade e quer fazer parte de uma transformação positiva no setor florestal, esta é sua oportunidade!

O que buscamos?

Suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • O profissional será responsável por conduzir, com precisão técnica e visão estratégica as atividades relacionadas ao tema descarbonização e sustentabilidade, garantindo a integração entre metas, indicadores e projetos de alto impacto nas unidades da Aperam.
  • Realizar o balanço completo de carbono da empresa, consolidando dados, análises e evidências das emissões próprias e de fornecedores.
  • Conduzir projetos estratégicos voltados para a neutralidade de carbono e sustentabilidade da empresa, alinhados às metas corporativas 2030.
  • Monitorar, semanalmente, os indicadores de descarbonização e sustentabilidade, garantindo atualização, organização e direcionamento das ações necessárias.
  • Atuar na interlocução constante com o corporativo, alinhando demandas, avanços e necessidades relacionadas ao tema.
  • Apoiar decisões estratégicas com base em análises técnicas, mantendo visão sistêmica dos impactos e oportunidades.
  • Utilizar conhecimentos em inventário de carbono — considerado um diferencial importante para a cadeira.
  • Garantir postura proativa, estratégica e orientada a resultados, mantendo alta confiabilidade nas informações geradas.

O perfil que estamos buscando para essa posição:

  • Formação em Engenharia Ambiental, Engenharia Florestal ou áreas afins;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • CNH B;
  • Vivência ou conhecimento em inventário de carbono (diferencial desejado), sustentabilidade ou assuntos afins;

Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Previdência privada.

  • Plano de medicamentos.
  • Reembolso de óculos.

  • Auxílio-creche.
  • Licença-paternidade e maternidade estendida.
  • Retorno de férias.
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (Remuneração variável)

Nosso processo seletivo

Nosso processo de seleção, de forma geral, é constituído das seguintes etapas: inscrição e análise dos perfis com avaliação de currículos, entrevistas e dinâmicas (se necessário) com time de gente e gestão e líderes, avaliações comportamentais e ou técnicas (se necessário) e exames admissionais.

title: International Treasury Coordinator
description:
Forno de Minas is a leading Brazilian food company with a strong heritage, recognized brands, and a growing international footprint. As the company expands its operations in the U.S. and Europe, financial governance, liquidity control, and operational excellence are critical to sustaining growth. We offer a collaborative environment with high exposure, autonomy, and direct interaction with senior leadership.

About the role

This is a highly specialized international treasury role, designed for a senior, autonomous professional.

The International Treasury Coordinator will operate independently, owning treasury, cash flow, and international banking operations across the United States, United Kingdom, and Europe.

This is not a transactional AP role.

It is a position with low payment volume but very high operational and compliance complexity, requiring strong judgment, technical depth, and end-to-end ownership.

Key responsibilities

Cash Flow & Liquidity Management

  • Build, manage, and continuously monitor short- and medium-term cash flow forecasts (including 13-week cash flow)
  • Ensure liquidity and funding availability for international operations
  • Analyze variances, assumptions, and scenarios impacting cash position

International Payments & Banking Operations

  • Execute and manage international payments across U.S. and European banking systems
  • Operate payment methods such as ACH, SWIFT, SEPA, wire transfers, and international payroll-related payments
  • Navigate banking environments without PIX or boletos
  • Manage FX transactions, payment cut-offs, bank holidays, and country-specific rules
  • Maintain strong relationships with international banks and service providers
  • Negotiate banking fees and service conditions when applicable

Accounts Payable, Receivable & Governance

  • Own the end-to-end international AP and AR flows, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timeliness
  • Partner with Accounting and local providers (e.G., Portugal accounting team) for validation and execution
  • Ensure payments align with accounting, tax, and contractual requirements
  • Apply strong governance, internal controls, and compliance standards

Cross-functional Partnership

  • Work closely with HR (international payrolls and benefits), Marketing (costs and campaigns), Accounting, FP&A, and Commercial
  • Understand accounting classifications (OPEX vs. CAPEX) and financial impacts
  • Act as a key finance partner in international operations

Profile we are looking for

  • A senior, autonomous, and highly reliable professional
  • Comfortable operating alone, without constant follow-ups
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Able to manage complex international routines with precision
  • Hands-on, detail-oriented, and resilient in a corporate governance environment
  • Strong communication skills to interact with global stakeholders

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, Finance, or related fields
  • Fluent English (mandatory / non-negotiable)
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in Treasury or International Finance
  • Proven experience with international payments, especially in the U.S.
  • Solid knowledge of cash flow management (build, monitor, analyze)
  • Strong understanding of financial mathematics
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Experience with ERP systems (SAP and/or Datasul – TOTVS)
  • Strong understanding of corporate governance and compliance

Nice to have

  • Experience with European banking operations
  • Spanish proficiency
  • Prior exposure to multinational or international business environments

Why join Forno de Minas

  • Strategic international role with high visibility
  • Opportunity to build and structure international treasury operations
  • High level of autonomy and trust
  • Direct interaction with senior leadership
  • Exposure to global financial operations and decision-making

title: International Treasury Specialist
description:
Forno de Minas is a leading Brazilian food company with a strong heritage, recognized brands, and a growing international footprint. As the company expands its operations in the U.S. and Europe, financial governance, liquidity control, and operational excellence are critical to sustaining growth. We offer a collaborative environment with high exposure, autonomy, and direct interaction with senior leadership.

About the role

This is a highly specialized international treasury role, designed for a senior, autonomous professional.

The International Treasury Specialist will operate independently, owning treasury, cash flow, and international banking operations across the United States, United Kingdom, and Europe.

This is not a transactional AP role.

It is a position with low payment volume but very high operational and compliance complexity, requiring strong judgment, technical depth, and end-to-end ownership.

Key responsibilities

Cash Flow & Liquidity Management

  • Build, manage, and continuously monitor short- and medium-term cash flow forecasts (including 13-week cash flow)
  • Ensure liquidity and funding availability for international operations
  • Analyze variances, assumptions, and scenarios impacting cash position

International Payments & Banking Operations

  • Execute and manage international payments across U.S. and European banking systems
  • Operate payment methods such as ACH, SWIFT, SEPA, wire transfers, and international payroll-related payments
  • Navigate banking environments without PIX or boletos
  • Manage FX transactions, payment cut-offs, bank holidays, and country-specific rules
  • Maintain strong relationships with international banks and service providers
  • Negotiate banking fees and service conditions when applicable

Accounts Payable, Receivable & Governance

  • Own the end-to-end international AP and AR flows, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timeliness
  • Partner with Accounting and local providers (e.G., Portugal accounting team) for validation and execution
  • Ensure payments align with accounting, tax, and contractual requirements
  • Apply strong governance, internal controls, and compliance standards

Cross-functional Partnership

  • Work closely with HR (international payrolls and benefits), Marketing (costs and campaigns), Accounting, FP&A, and Commercial
  • Understand accounting classifications (OPEX vs. CAPEX) and financial impacts
  • Act as a key finance partner in international operations

Profile we are looking for

  • A senior, autonomous, and highly reliable professional
  • Comfortable operating alone, without constant follow-ups
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Able to manage complex international routines with precision
  • Hands-on, detail-oriented, and resilient in a corporate governance environment
  • Strong communication skills to interact with global stakeholders

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, Finance, or related fields
  • Fluent English (mandatory / non-negotiable)
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in Treasury or International Finance
  • Proven experience with international payments, especially in the U.S.
  • Solid knowledge of cash flow management (build, monitor, analyze)
  • Strong understanding of financial mathematics
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Experience with ERP systems (SAP and/or Datasul – TOTVS)
  • Strong understanding of corporate governance and compliance

Nice to have

  • Experience with European banking operations
  • Spanish proficiency
  • Prior exposure to multinational or international business environments

Why join Forno de Minas

  • Strategic international role with high visibility
  • Opportunity to build and structure international treasury operations
  • High level of autonomy and trust
  • Direct interaction with senior leadership
  • Exposure to global financial operations and decision-making

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview

Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company's foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.

Key Responsibilities

Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.G., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.G., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.

Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving;
    ability to identify theroot causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution;
    capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.

Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

  • Long-term engagement: 1 year, renewable
  • Primarily remote, with sporadic national travel as needed

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!

  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role;
instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a "bench" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.

What you'll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional "human-in-the-loop" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.

What you'll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.G., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.

Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again;
simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.

Links to more information on Prolific

Website

Youtube

Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

  • Deep expertise in mobile application development (Android and/or iOS)
  • Proven experience designing scalable microservices and RESTful API architectures

Tempo indeterminado.

title: Desenvolvedor Para Ios

comprometimento não é só um pensamento;

title: Fincrime Escalations Officer
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to WorkTM. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut's efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.

We're looking for an Escalations Officer to ensure effective and compliant suspicious activity reporting in Brazil. You'll be performing assessments and making decisions on cases, which are escalated from the first line of defence.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Acting as the escalation point for suspicious activity cases
  • Ensuring accurate and timely SARs are submitted according to local requirements
  • Responding to regulatory inquiries and other requests from local authorities related to SARs
  • Managing queries requiring a second line of defence review
  • Working with the MLRO and escalating significant cases
  • Monitoring and detecting rare or new patterns, and reporting emerging trends in suspicious activity
  • Resolving escalated cases, following expected resolution times
  • Participating in projects with management as required
  • Collaborating on training initiatives and implementation of new processes

What you'll need

  • Experience as a compliance/FinCrime officer in a major financial institution
  • Experience in FinCrime operations acting as the escalation point
  • Deep knowledge of AML and sanctions regulations
  • Experience using internal and external systems and databases to conduct investigations
  • The ability to review policies and procedures and advise if changes are required
  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to analyse complex information to identify the key issue/action and drive resolutions
  • The ability to present a summary and conclusion to management promptly, including clear proposals to implement appropriate steps to mitigate risk and/or monitor it
  • An understanding of payment systems and markets with a focus on technology and mobile applications
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it's a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
Job Summary

The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia's headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.

Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities

  • Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials.
  • Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required.
  • Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects.
  • Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines.
  • Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies.
  • Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation.
  • In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required.
  • Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials.
  • Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable.
  • Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively
  • Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions.
  • Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable.
  • Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product.
  • Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead.
  • Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans.
  • Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation.
  • Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report.
  • Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites.
  • Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required
  • Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct
  • Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated
  • Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives.
  • Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed.
  • Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management.
  • Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.).
  • Experience managing clinical project team personnel.
  • Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies.
  • Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations.
  • Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process.
  • Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US.
  • Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members.
  • Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a 'can-do' attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers.
  • Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate.
  • Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment.
  • Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment.
  • Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).
  • .
  • Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers.
  • Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business.
  • Must be fluent in English

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
About the Company

Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.

About the Role

We are looking for a BI Analyst to own and improve business reporting across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, merchant performance, and operations. This role is focused on dashboards, KPI tracking, reporting consistency, metric definitions, and turning business questions into clear, actionable insights.

You will work closely with leadership, operations, product, and engineering to make data easier to understand, easier to trust, and more useful in day-to-day decision-making.

Responsibilities

  • Own dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking across core business areas
  • Build and maintain reporting that gives teams clear visibility into fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance
  • Write and optimize SQL for reporting, analysis, and data validation
  • Define, document, and improve business metrics so teams are working from consistent numbers
  • Analyze trends, anomalies, and performance changes across key datasets
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into practical reporting and analysis
  • Improve the usability, accuracy, and trustworthiness of existing reports and dashboards
  • Identify reporting gaps, data inconsistencies, and metric definition issues
  • Create clear visualizations and present findings in a business-friendly way
  • Support self-service reporting and help teams use data more effectively

Requirements

  • Strong SQL skills
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring business reporting
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics, reporting, and analysis
  • Experience working with production data and validating reporting accuracy
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience defining and maintaining KPIs or business metrics
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment
  • Able to pass a background check

Preferred

  • Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, risk, or other operational data
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools
  • Experience working with large datasets in a business reporting environment
  • Experience with AWS-based data environments
  • Basic Python skills for ad hoc analysis or validation
  • Experience with ClickHouse or similar analytical databases

title: Kdb+/Q Developer – Time Series Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced KDB+/Q Developer to design, build, and maintain ultra-high-performance data platforms. You will work on systems that process large-scale real-time (tick) and historical datasets, ensuring extreme low latency and reliability for mission-critical environments such as trading, IoT, and telemetry.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop high-performance solutions in q/KDB+ for both in-memory and on-disk data structures (splayed and partitioned databases).
  • Architect and optimize real-time data pipelines, including Ticker Plants, Chained Tickers, and Real-Time Databases (RDB).
  • Maintain and enhance Historical Databases (HDB), ensuring millisecond-level performance over terabyte-scale datasets.
  • Identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks across CPU, memory, and I/O layers, applying vectorized programming best practices.
  • Develop and maintain integrations between KDB+ and external systems using Python (PyQ/EmbedPy), Java, or C++.
  • Support production systems operating in high-pressure, real-time environments.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with KDB+ and q, including strong system design expertise.
  • Deep understanding of vectorized programming in q, leveraging primitives such as adverbs, over, and scan.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux/Unix environments (shell scripting, memory management, file systems).
  • Solid understanding of low-latency architecture and hardware considerations (RAM vs SSD optimization).
  • Proven ability to solve complex problems in real-time, high-performance systems.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (mandatory).

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with messaging systems such as Kafka, Solace, or frameworks like Aqua / TorQ.
  • Background in capital markets (Equities, FX, Fixed Income) or large-scale IoT / sensor data platforms.
  • Experience working in mission-critical production or trading environments.

Additional Information:

  • Fully remote position (on-site presence in São Paulo is a plus).
  • Competitive rate to be defined.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge, high-throughput real-time data systems at scale.

title: Project Coordinator – Renovations, Permits & Timelines
description:
Project Coordinator – Renovations, Permits & Timelines

Why Work for Us?

At Blue Gems, we're obsessed with building smart, efficient systems that keep vacation rentals running seamlessly. We manage over 150 short-term rental homes in Florida, handling everything from guest experience to maintenance and cleaning, so our property owners and guests can enjoy peace of mind.

We're a lean, global team of 25+ (primarily in LATAM) who value ownership, honesty, and making things better every day. We offer stable, long-term roles with bimonthly pay and plenty of opportunities to grow with us.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy coordinating multiple moving parts, and want to be part of a high-performing team, keep reading.

Who We Are and What We Are Looking For

We're looking for a Project Coordinator who can keep calm under pressure, coordinate multiple moving parts, and manage renovation projects across our portfolio, including renovations, designs, permits, and timelines.

This isn't a quiet desk job, its active coordination, follow-ups, and ensuring projects move forward without delays.

Your Four Primary Responsibilities/Objectives Will Be:

  • Renovation Project Coordination – Manage multiple renovation projects, ensuring timelines and execution stay on track
  • Permits & Compliance Tracking – Coordinate permits, approvals, and ensure projects meet local requirements
  • Vendor & Contractor Coordination – Communicate with contractors and technicians to ensure work is completed correctly and on time
  • Timeline & Progress Management – Track milestones, follow up on delays, and ensure projects move forward without gaps

What Will Our Project Coordinator Look Like?

Who You Are:

  • Calm, decisive problem solver who can manage multiple ongoing projects
  • Strong communicator with clear spoken and written English and Portuguese
  • Extremely detail-oriented and highly organized
  • Tech-savvy with Notion, Airtable, Slack, Google Drive, and AI tools
  • Proactive, you spot issues early and follow through until resolved

Who You Are Not:

  • Someone who loses track of timelines or misses follow-ups
  • Passive or waiting to be told what to do
  • Disorganized or unable to manage multiple projects at once

Must-Have Qualifications:

  • Fluent Portuguese (required)
  • Strong English speaking and writing skills
  • Experience coordinating projects, renovations, or construction-related work
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Highly detail-oriented and proactive mindset
  • Comfort working with tools like Notion, Slack, Google Drive
  • 1+ years of Hospitality experience
  • 1+ years of work experience with Maintenance Management

Nice-to-Have Qualifications:

  • Experience in short-term rentals or property management
  • Familiarity with STR tools such as Guesty, Breezeway, or similar platforms (used in day-to-day operations)
  • Experience coordinating with field technicians or vendors

3 Key Responsibilities This Person Will Be Driving / Responsible For:

  • Managing renovation timelines and ensuring execution stays on track
  • Coordinating contractors, technicians, and project updates
  • Tracking permits, approvals, and project progress

Define What Success Means in This Role:

  • Projects move forward without delays or gaps
  • Contractors and technicians are aligned and informed
  • Permits and approvals are handled on time
  • All project updates and tracking are accurate and up to date

Timeframe for Success:

  • Within 30 Days: Understands current projects, tools, and workflows
  • Within 90 Days: Independently managing multiple projects and timelines
  • Within 6–12 Months: Driving improvements in project coordination and execution

Clarity as a Whole/Team:

This Role Owns:

  • Renovation project coordination
  • Contractor and vendor communication
  • Permits and compliance tracking
  • Timeline tracking and follow-ups

This Role Does Not Own:

  • Real-time maintenance dispatch
  • Direct supervision of technicians outside coordination duties
  • Guest communication unrelated to projects

Compensation:

Full-time (48 hrs/week)

$1,000 – $1,500 USD/month

Paid Time Off (PTO)

Stable, long-term role with global team

title: Engenheiro De Dados Especialista
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Arquiteto De Software
description:
A VMetrix é uma empresa SaaS que desenvolve uma plataforma financeira integral utilizada por bancos, fundos de pensão, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e asset managers no Chile e na América Latina. Nossa plataforma cobre o ciclo completo de gestão de investimentos: desde a captura de operações e gestão do ciclo de vida transacional, até a precificação, contabilidade, risco de mercado, compliance regulatório e reporting.

Propósito do Cargo

Arquiteto de Software é responsável por definir, evoluir e governar a arquitetura técnica da plataforma VMetrix. Este papel atua como ponte entre os requisitos de negócio financeiro, as restrições regulatórias e a implementação técnica, garantindo que as decisões arquiteturais suportem a escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e compliance da plataforma a longo prazo. Lidera o design dos sistemas mais complexos, estabelece os padrões técnicos para toda a equipe de desenvolvimento e governa a adoção estratégica de ferramentas de IA no ciclo de engenharia.

Responsabilidades Principais:

Desenvolvimento e Manutenção da Plataforma

  • Desenvolver e manter módulos core da plataforma: ciclo de vida transacional (captura, validação, aprovação, liquidação), precificação de instrumentos, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado e reporting regulatório.
  • Implementar lógica de negócio financeiro complexa: processos de precificação mark-to-market, cálculos de P&L, accruals, amortizações, simulações end-of-day e processos batch de fechamento.
  • Escrever código bem estruturado, eficiente, testável e aderente aos padrões arquiteturais definidos pela equipe de Arquitetura.
  • Identificar bugs, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria na base de código, propondo e implementando soluções com foco em qualidade e manutenibilidade.
  • Antecipar necessidades futuras do sistema, sendo proativo na identificação de riscos técnicos e propondo soluções antes que se tornem impedimentos.

Arquitetura de Dados e PL/SQL

  • Projetar e otimizar procedures PL/SQL em Oracle 21c, incluindo pipelined functions, estratégias com Global Temporary Tables e packages de cálculo financeiro.
  • Construir APIs REST robustas para integração com sistemas externos (ERPs, sistemas contábeis, provedores de dados de mercado), cobrindo múltiplas classes de ativos.
  • Participar no design de motores genéricos com arquitetura metadata-driven, múltiplas estratégias de execução e cache de alto desempenho.

Qualidade, Testes e Revisão de Código

  • Analisar, depurar e testar software de forma sistemática, garantindo conformidade com as especificações técnicas definidas.
  • Realizar revisões de código com foco em qualidade, segurança, performance e aderência aos padrões arquiteturais da plataforma.
  • Definir e aplicar estratégias de testes (unitários, integração, contrato) em colaboração com o time de Arquitetura.
  • Garantir que os módulos desenvolvidos sejam seguros, estáveis e aderentes às exigências regulatórias dos mercados atendidos.

Colaboração Técnica e Mentoria

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Arquiteto de Software e Tech Leads para o cumprimento das diretrizes técnicas e das demandas da área.
  • Realizar mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores juniores e plenos: revisões de design, pair programming e transferência de conhecimento do domínio financeiro.
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas de equipe para discussão e alinhamento de demandas, soluções e prioridades.
  • Monitorar tendências e tecnologias, contribuindo com propostas de melhoria de processos e ferramentas utilizadas no desenvolvimento dos produtos da empresa.

Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA

  • Utilizar ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) de forma produtiva e responsável no ciclo diário de desenvolvimento: geração de código, revisão, debugging e escrita de testes.
  • Elaborar e consumir especificações técnicas otimizadas para uso com LLMs, garantindo que a documentação sirva tanto para a equipe quanto como contexto de alta qualidade para ferramentas de IA generativa.
  • Aplicar engenharia de prompts no contexto de desenvolvimento: formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem.

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Formação acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou certificações técnicas relevantes são diferenciais.
  • 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Domínio avançado de Java 8+ e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, transações, testes).
  • Experiência sólida em Oracle Database (PL/SQL, pipelined functions, partitioning, performance tuning, schemas complexos).
  • Conhecimento prático de Kubernetes (OKE) e deployments em containers (Docker, WebLogic em OKE).
  • Experiência com padrões de arquitetura: metadata-driven designs, cache distribuído (Caffeine/Redis), event-driven, repository pattern.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento modernas: Git e Git Flow, pipelines CI/CD, Postman/OpenAPI.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou similares — incluindo uso em geração de código, escrita de testes, refatoração e debugging.
  • Capacidade de engenharia de prompts aplicada ao desenvolvimento: saber formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem.
  • Capacidade de ler e produzir especificações técnicas detalhadas em formato Markdown.

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento do domínio financeiro: renda fixa, renda variável, derivativos, fundos de investimento, gestão de portfólios, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado.
  • Experiência com regulação financeira brasileira ou latino-americana (CVM, BACEN, ANBIMA, ou órgãos equivalentes).
  • Experiência com integrações Office (Excel Add-ins) para plataformas SaaS financeiras.
  • Familiaridade com padrões da indústria financeira (FpML, ISDA, ou outros).
  • Experiência com observabilidade: Grafana, métricas de aplicação, alerting.
  • Conhecimento de práticas GitOps e versionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC).
  • Familiaridade com testes de contrato (contract testing) e testes de integração em arquiteturas de microsserviços.
  • Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações equivalentes em tecnologias do stack.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas de tecnologia, engenharia ou gestão de inovação.

Processo de Candidatura:

  • Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo LinkedIn.
  • Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo.
  • Entrevista com Líder e RH:Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência.
  • Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não.

Por que trabalhar na VMetrix

Na VMetrix, não buscamos "fazer mais barulho", mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva.

Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional.

Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

title: Latin America Sales Representative

title: Devops Engineer
description:
Remote

We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to help design, build, and operate reliable cloud infrastructure systems. title: Business Analyst
description:

  • Solid understanding of Agile principles and frameworks (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder‐management skills.

Nice to Have
